transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I'm here because of an ongoing situation at my apartment building. It’s been happening for months now. The property manager and certain people there are trying to pressure me out. 

...They do things. Misdelivering my mail. Making noises in the walls at very specific times. Little comments from the neighbors when I walk by. They try to give me explanations or show me paperwork to justify it all, but... I can see the pattern. Nothing they say changes what I can clearly see happening.

Can you tell me more about the pattern you see? Specifically, do you believe these actions by the property manager and neighbors are intentionally targeted at you, and how strongly do you believe this is happening?

...I thought I just explained that. Yes, it is directed at me. 

The property manager and those specific people in the building... they are using the mail, the timed noises, the comments. It is all designed to pressure me out of the apartment. 

I don't know why you are asking how strongly I believe it. It isn't a belief, it's just what is happening. No amount of their paperwork or... supposed explanations... is going to change the pattern I can clearly see. I don't really see what else there is to say about it.
Have you noticed any sounds or sights that others around you don't seem to notice, especially during these incidents with the property manager or neighbors?

...No. I don't really know what you're implying with that. 

I'm not seeing things, if that's what you mean. The noises I mentioned... anyone standing in my apartment would hear them. I only see and hear what is actually there. I don't know why you'd ask that.
Have you had a general sense or feeling that something was off or not quite right, even before you noticed these specific actions from the property manager and neighbors?

No. I didn't have any... feelings about it. 

Things were perfectly normal until they started doing these things. There wasn't some vague sense that something was wrong beforehand, if that's what you're getting at. It just... started happening. That's all.
Have you ever had any unusual thoughts or beliefs that others might find strange or hard to believe, outside of what you’ve already described about the property manager and your neighbors?

...No. I don't have unusual beliefs. 

I'm an analyst... I deal with facts. Aside from what is currently happening at my building, my life is completely normal. I go to work, I do my job. There isn't anything else to tell you.

Have you ever had any other situations or experiences that you felt were part of a larger pattern of being targeted or plotted against, even if they seemed unrelated to the issues at your apartment building?

...No. There's no other pattern. 

It's just... what I already told you about the building. I don't have problems anywhere else. Just there. I don't know what else you want me to say about it.
